subject.title: WORKING: All Microsoft Issues and PRs (refresh)

question: Should OpenClaw keep a committed Microsoft ecosystem tracker and generator, or should this tracking stay in PR-body/admin tooling outside the source tree?
rationale: The patch adds a new maintainer workflow surface, not a product bug fix, and the right permanent home for this tracker requires maintainer intent before automation should repair or merge it.

options.title: Keep a guarded repo tracker
options.body: Require the generator check mode, safe PR-body escaping, label-faithful priorities, no changelog edit, and redacted real behavior proof before review continues.

options.title: Keep it PR-body only
options.body: Drop the committed file and script, and continue using PR comments/body updates for the Microsoft queue.

options.title: Move to existing admin tooling
options.body: Close or pause this PR in favor of GitHub Projects, saved searches, or another maintainer-owned dashboard.

recommendation.title: Keep a guarded repo tracker
recommendation.body: Require the generator check mode, safe PR-body escaping, label-faithful priorities, no changelog edit, and redacted real behavior proof before review continues.

likelyOwner.reason: BradGroux owns the current tracker refresh and has prior Microsoft/Teams-area history, so they are the best first routing point before a repo maintainer decides the permanent home.
